name: Bug Fixes (unofficial patch set)
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
description: Bundled, opt-in fixes for upstream Angband 4.2.6 bugs, in the model of an unofficial patch. The mod itself is OFF by default, like every mod; enable it and you get the whole patch set, with each fix a named toggle in this mod's Fixes & tweaks submenu that you can switch off individually. With the mod disabled, core stays faithful to 4.2.6, bugs included. See docs/modding/BUG_FIXES.md for the upstream issue/PR/commit each fix cites.

rules.title: No duplicate unique kills in history (#4245)
rules.description: A unique reached again through a shape-change or projection death path no longer logs a second 'Killed X' entry in your character history.

rules.title: Save noise and scent trails (#4605)
rules.description: Persists the noise and scent heatmaps in the save, so monsters track you identically after a save/reload as they would have without one.

rules.title: Strict object-list ordering (#4664)
rules.description: Gives the floor object list a deterministic total order (a geometric tiebreak after distance), so equal-distance items never reorder unexpectedly.

rules.title: Prevent duplicate artifacts (#4510)
rules.description: Adds a defensive re-check so an object already carrying a created artifact can never be committed as that artifact a second time.

rules.title: Always a reachable up and down staircase
rules.description: Vanilla level generation can seal a staircase inside a vault it never tunnelled into, leaving about 10% of floors with no walkable staircase in one direction (usually up, since a level gets only 1-2 up stairs but 3-4 down). This adds one reachable staircase on such a floor. It changes the layout of the levels it repairs, so a character played with this on is not layout-identical to one played without it.

rules.title: Misc. string fixes
rules.description: Cosmetic corrections to Angband 4.2.6's own message text. Measured rather than assumed: 38 messages put TWO spaces after a sentence ("Saving failed.  Try again? "), which this collapses to one, and a sweep for misspellings across every msg()/msgt()/get_check() literal found NONE - so spacing is all there is to fix today. Purely presentational: no message changes meaning, and nothing about gameplay changes.
